results.references: - Zeyuan Allen-Zhu, Zheng Qu, Peter Richtárik, Yang Yuan. [Even Faster Accelerated Coordinate Descent Using Non-Uniform Sampling](https://arxiv.org/pdf/1512.09103v3). 2016 (ICML; full preprint v3, May 2016; first preprint December 2015). Complexity: $O((\sum_{i=1}^{d}\sqrt{L_i/\mu})(1+\log(\Delta/\varepsilon)))$ fixed exact coordinate-gradient oracle calls for $\mathbb E[f(y_T)-f(x^*)]\le\varepsilon$, using NU_ACDM, when $0<\varepsilon<\Delta$; initialization requires no oracle calls, and zero calls suffice when $\varepsilon\ge\Delta$.

problem_class.label: convex
problem_class.details: Unconstrained differentiable convex minimization over R^d, with an attained global minimum.
problem_class.evidence: LongTails/Setups/CoordinateSmoothStronglyConvex.lean: spec.Instance and spec.admissible gradient, strong-convexity, and minimizer clauses.

problem_class.label: strongly_convex
problem_class.details: For all x,y, f(y) ≥ f(x)+⟨∇f(x),y−x⟩+(μ/2)‖y−x‖², with μ>0.

oracle.label: coordinate_gradient
oracle.details: A query (i,x) returns exactly ∇f(x)_i. Replies are independent of call index and oracle seed; there is no oracle error. Each scalar coordinate derivative counts as one call.
oracle.evidence: LongTails/Setups/CoordinateSmoothStronglyConvex.lean: spec.Query, spec.Reply, and spec.admissible oracle-answer equality; LongTails/Template.lean: execute and Convergence.

distinctive_assumptions.label: finite_dimensional
distinctive_assumptions.details: The ambient space is Euclidean R^d with d≥1 and its standard inner product and norm.

distinctive_assumptions.label: other
distinctive_assumptions.details: Known coordinate smoothness bounds satisfy L_i≥μ: f(x+t e_i)≤f(x)+t∇f(x)_i+(L_i/2)t². All parameters d,L,μ,Δ,ε,x0 are public, with Δ≥0 and ε>0. A minimizer x* satisfies f(x0)−f(x*)≤Δ; f is hidden.
distinctive_assumptions.evidence: LongTails/Setups/CoordinateSmoothStronglyConvex.lean: Params, spec.Public, spec.publicInput, spec.valid, and spec.admissible coordinate-smoothness and initialization clauses.

accuracy.label: objective_gap
accuracy.details: The output X lies in R^d and satisfies E[f(X)−f(x*)]≤ε for a global minimizer x*. The output must be measurable and its objective gap integrable.

accuracy.label: expected
accuracy.details: The objective-gap guarantee is in expectation over the product of algorithm and oracle seed laws. Oracle cost is bounded for every seed by the supplied fixed budget.
accuracy.evidence: LongTails/Setups/CoordinateSmoothStronglyConvex.lean: spec.successful integral inequality; LongTails/Template.lean: Convergence seed-product measure and per-seed call bound.

setup_category.label: classical
setup_category.reason: Finite-dimensional strongly convex minimization with known coordinate smoothness, exact coordinate derivatives, and expected objective-gap accuracy is a standard coordinate-descent formulation.
